description: This is a C# test class for the AccountController's SignIn functionalities, including login page access, form validation, and profile updates, implemented using Xunit and ASP.NET Core testing libraries.

classes.name: AccountControllerSignIn
classes.description: A test class for the AccountController SignIn actions, including login page retrieval, login form submission, token validation, and profile update tests.

methods.name: ReturnsSignInScreenOnGet
methods.description: Tests that GET request to login page returns a page containing specific email address.

methods.name: RegexMatchesValidRequestVerificationToken
methods.description: Validates that the regex correctly extracts the request verification token from HTML input.

methods.name: ReturnsFormWithRequestVerificationToken
methods.description: Tests that the login page contains a valid request verification token.

methods.name: ReturnsSuccessfulSignInOnPostWithValidCredentials
methods.description: Simulates a login attempt with valid credentials and checks for redirection to home page.

methods.name: UpdatePhoneNumberProfile
methods.description: Performs login, navigates to profile page, updates phone number, and verifies update.
